scope: 通用广告与消费者保护（CAA Act 2003）+ 价格标示 + 商品说明/担保 + 预包装商品计量 + 标准与强制认证准入 + 电信设备准入 + 隐私告知（PDPA 2022）。语言义务见 README（未发现非食品消费品的通用三语法定要求）。
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示可在‘法条原文 + 页面原文’同时成立时给出规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判‘需要证明’；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的条目必须人工复核后才能进入报告结论。
source_note: LK1/LK3/LK4/LK5 为斯里兰卡议会官网发布的法案扫描件（无文本层），引文由 300dpi OCR 提取后逐条目视比对原页面；LK2 为数字版 PDF，可直接文本比对。详见 SOURCES.md。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 任何交易者在经营中不得从事误导性或欺骗性行为，包括可能误导或欺骗消费者或其他交易者的行为；判断看整体印象与语境，不只看单个词。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面原文与上下文（标题、图、价格区、免责声明位置）、投放时间与受众；如涉及事实性矛盾，附规格书或检测报告。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属 s.60(5) 一般罚则：法人初犯罚款 1 万–10 万卢比；个人初犯 1,000–10,000 卢比或 6 个月以下监禁。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No trader shall, in the course of a trade or business, engage in any type of conduct that is misleading or deceptive or is likely to mislead or deceive the consumer or any other trader.
rules.notes: 斯里兰卡没有类似中国广告法的绝对化用语清单；‘best/no.1’是否构成问题取决于整体印象与可证实性。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 不得虚假表示商品或服务具有特定标准、质量或等级，也不得虚假表示商品为特定款式或型号。
rules.evidence_needed: 标准编号与发证机构、检测报告（实验室资质、方法与日期）、型号与页面对应关系、进货凭证。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属 s.60(5) 一般罚则：法人初犯罚款 1 万–10 万卢比。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: falsely represents that goods or services are of a particular standard, quality or grade, or that goods are of a particular style or model ;
rules.notes: 只能判‘需要证明’，不能判声称真假。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 不得虚假表示商品是新的；翻新机、开箱机、展示机按新品描述属此条。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品状态说明、翻新/开箱标注位置、进货与序列号记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属 s.60(5) 一般罚则：法人初犯罚款 1 万–10 万卢比。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: falsely represents that goods are new ;
rules.notes: 页面未标注翻新/开箱状态时，只能写‘页面未说明商品状态，需向商家核实’，不得推断为二手。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品或服务具有其实际并不具备的赞助、批准、性能、特性、配件、用途或益处。
rules.evidence_needed: 奖项主办方与年份、专利号、检测报告（菌种、方法、实验室）、性能测试条件。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属 s.60(5) 一般罚则：法人初犯罚款 1 万–10 万卢比。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: represents that goods or services have sponsorship, approval, performance, characteristics accessories, uses or benefits they do not have ;
rules.notes: 官方扫描件中该款在 characteristics 与 accessories 之间无逗号，疑为排印脱漏；引文照录原样，不作补正。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 不得表示交易者拥有其实际并不拥有的赞助、批准或关联关系（如‘官方授权’‘官方合作’）。
rules.evidence_needed: 授权书/合作协议、授权方名称与有效期、授权范围是否覆盖该品类与该站点。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属 s.60(5) 一般罚则：法人初犯罚款 1 万–10 万卢比。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: represents that such trader has a sponsorship approval or affiliation he does not have ;
rules.notes: ‘official’ 在页面常指官方直营，需结合公司主体判断。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 不得就降价或涨价的存在或幅度作出虚假或误导性陈述；划线价、折扣幅度与‘限时’必须有真实依据。
rules.evidence_needed: 原价的实际销售记录与持续时间、折扣基准、活动起止时间截图。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属 s.60(5) 一般罚则：法人初犯罚款 1 万–10 万卢比。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: makes false or misleading statements concerning the existence of, or amounts of price reduction or price increase ;
rules.notes: 斯里兰卡没有类似澳大利亚 ACL s.48 的‘单一价格’条文；价格比较的真实性依本条判断。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 不得就商品、服务、替换件或维修的必要性作出虚假或误导性陈述（如制造紧迫感、宣称必须更换原厂件）。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品说明书中的维护周期、维修记录、替换件规格要求；页面紧迫感表述的上下文。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属 s.60(5) 一般罚则：法人初犯罚款 1 万–10 万卢比。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: makes false or misleading statements concerning the need for any goods, services, replacements or repairs ; or
rules.notes: ‘需要更换/维修’是否属实属语境判断。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 不得就任何保证或担保的存在或效力作出虚假或误导性陈述；页面承诺的保修范围与期限须与随货保修条款一致。
rules.evidence_needed: 保修条款全文、保修主体（品牌/卖家/第三方）、期限与除外条款、页面承诺截图。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属 s.60(5) 一般罚则：法人初犯罚款 1 万–10 万卢比。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: makes false or misleading statements concerning the existence or effect of any warranty or guarantee,
rules.notes: 另见 s.32(1)：供货合同含默示担保，商品须符合 s.12 确定的标准。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 消费者事务局可就标签、价格标示、包装、销售或制造发出一般性指令；制造商与交易者必须遵守，不遵守即构成该法项下的 offence。指令须在宪报及僧伽罗语、泰米尔语、英语报纸各一份公告。
rules.evidence_needed: 适用品类是否已有 CAA 指令（宪报编号与生效日）、指令要求的标签要素、商品实物标签照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: s.10(3)：不遵守指令即属犯罪，罚则依 s.60(5)（法人初犯 1 万–10 万卢比）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: issue general directions to manufacturers or traders in respect of labelling, price marking, packeting, sale or manufacture of any goods ; and
rules.notes: 义务的来源是‘指令’而非本条本身；v0.1 未取得 CAA 已发布指令的完整清单，见 README open questions #1。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 不得移除、涂改、擦除或污损依 s.10(1) 指令所需商品的标签、说明或价格标记；也不得销售此类标记已被移除或涂改的商品。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品与包装照片（标签是否完整、是否有二次贴标痕迹）、进货凭证。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属 s.60(5) 一般罚则：法人初犯罚款 1 万–10 万卢比。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any person who removes, alters, obliterates, erases or defaces any label, description or price mark on any goods in respect of which a direction under subsection (1) has been issued, or sells or offers for sale any such goods from or on which the label, description or price mark has been removed, altered, obliterated, erased or defaced, shall be guilty of an offence under this Act.

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 任何人不得以高于依 s.10 指令在商品上标示的价格销售或要约销售该商品；页面标价即为可执行上限。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面标价截图、结算页价格、促销前后价格对照。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属 s.60(5) 一般罚则：法人初犯罚款 1 万–10 万卢比。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any person who sells or offers to sell any goods above the price marked on the goods in accordance with a direction issued under section 10, shall be guilty of an offence under this Act.
rules.notes: 适用于已有 CAA 价格标示指令的商品；无指令时该条不自动适用。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 交易者须在营业场所显眼处展示可售商品最高零售价或批发价的告示（商品本身、包装或法律要求的其他方式已标价者除外）。
rules.evidence_needed: 线下门店照片；纯线上店铺需确认‘营业场所’是否延伸至网店，属法律解释问题。
rules.penalty_or_note: 属 s.60(5) 一般罚则：法人初犯罚款 1 万–10 万卢比。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Every trader shall exhibit conspicuously in his place of business, a notice specifying the maximum retail or wholesale price, as the case may be, of goods available for sale in his place of business other than the price of any goods, the price of which is marked on the goods itself or on the wrapper or pack containing it or marked in any other manner as may be required by any law.
rules.notes: 条文针对‘place of business’的实体告示；对跨境独立站的适用性未核，见 README open questions #2。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 消费供货合同含默示担保：所供商品或服务须符合依 s.12 确定的标准与规格，且服务须以应有谨慎与技能提供。
rules.evidence_needed: 适用标准编号（CAA s.12 公告或 SLS 标准）、检测报告、保修与售后条款。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事默示担保，救济为损害赔偿等民事途径；s.60 罚则不直接适用于本条。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the goods supplied or services provided will be in conformity with the standards and specifications determined under section 12 of this Act ; and
rules.notes: 本条是民事担保，不是刑事罚则；报告中不得写成‘将被罚款’。

rules.law_name: Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 消费者事务局法
rules.requirement: 违反本法其他条款（含 s.10(3)、s.11、s.30、s.31）者，经治安法官审判定罪后按 s.60(5) 处罚。
rules.evidence_needed: 违规条款、主体类型（个人/法人）、是否再犯。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Every person who acts in contravention of any provision of this Act, (other than the provisions referred to in subsections (1), (2), (3) and (4) of this section) or any requirements imposed under any such provision, or any regulations made under section 72, shall be guilty of an offence under this Act and shall, on conviction after trial before a Magistrate, be liable —
rules.notes: 罚则为 2003 年文本；后续修正案是否上调未核（见 README open questions #3）。只写上限，不写‘必然处罚’。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022 个人数据保护法
rules.requirement: 控制者须在收集时向数据主体提供控制者（及适用时的代表）的身份与联系方式。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策中的运营主体名称、注册地址、联系邮箱/电话；与页面底部公司信息是否一致。
rules.penalty_or_note: PDPA 未设刑事罚金；数据保护局可依 s.35 发出指令（停止处理、整改、赔偿）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the identity and contact details of the controller and where applicable of the controller’s representative;

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022 个人数据保护法
rules.requirement: 须告知个人数据被处理的目的以及处理的正当性依据（legal basis）。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策中的目的清单（订单履行、营销、分析等）与对应的正当性依据（同意/合同/正当利益等）。
rules.penalty_or_note: PDPA 未设刑事罚金；可依 s.35 发指令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the intended purposes for which the personal data is processed and the legal basis for the processing;
rules.notes: 正当性依据见 Schedule I（同意等）与 Schedule II。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022 个人数据保护法
rules.requirement: 以同意为基础处理时，须告知数据主体有权随时撤回同意、撤回的程序，且撤回不影响撤回前已进行处理的效力（原文 lawfulness）。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策中的撤回同意条款、退订/撤回入口是否可达。
rules.penalty_or_note: PDPA 未设刑事罚金；可依 s.35 发指令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: where processing is intended to be based on consent pursuant to item (a) of Schedule I and item (a) of Schedule II, the existence of the right of the data subject to withdraw his consent, and the procedure for such withdrawal, without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal;

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022 个人数据保护法
rules.requirement: 须告知数据主体第二部分所赋权利的行使方式，以及向数据保护局投诉的权利。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策中的权利清单（查阅、更正、删除、反对等）与投诉渠道（数据保护局联系方式）。
rules.penalty_or_note: PDPA 未设刑事罚金；可依 s.35 发指令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the existence of and procedure for the exercise of rights of the data subject referred to in Part II; … the existence of a right to file complaints to the Authority;
rules.notes: 两小项合并引用，原文为 Schedule V 1(j) 与 1(k) 两条。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022 个人数据保护法
rules.requirement: 须告知个人数据的保存期限；期限无法确定时，须告知确定期限的标准。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策中的保留期限条款（如‘订单数据保留 5 年’或‘按税务法要求’）。
rules.penalty_or_note: PDPA 未设刑事罚金；可依 s.35 发指令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the period for which the personal data shall be retained in terms of section 9 or where such period is not known, the criteria for determining such period;

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022 个人数据保护法
rules.requirement: 如拟进行跨境传输，须告知该跨境传输的相关信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策中的跨境传输条款、接收方所在国家、传输依据（同意/合同必要/充分保护认定等）。
rules.penalty_or_note: PDPA 未设刑事罚金；可依 s.35 发指令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: information regarding any cross-border transfer of the personal data that the controller intends to carry out, if applicable;
rules.notes: 对中国卖家尤其相关：订单与客服数据回传中国即属跨境传输。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022 个人数据保护法
rules.requirement: 上述告知须以书面或电子方式提供，形式简洁、透明、易懂且易于获取。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策的可达路径（首页/结算页链接）、语言、层级与篇幅；是否需多次跳转或仅存在于注册协议。
rules.penalty_or_note: PDPA 未设刑事罚金；可依 s.35 发指令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A controller shall, provide data subjects— (a) the information referred to in Schedule V; and (b) the information regarding any decision taken pursuant to a request made under PART II of this Act, in writing or by electronic means and in a concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible form.
rules.notes: 无‘必须有隐私政策页面’的明文；义务是收集时的告知与可达性。

rules.law_name: Measurement Units, Standards and Services Act, No. 35 of 1995 计量单位、标准与服务法
rules.requirement: 在斯里兰卡订立的买卖、交付、计量合同及为销售而进行的包装，须使用第三附表第一部分所列的法定计量单位（公制）。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面规格中的单位标注（尺寸、重量、容量）、是否同时给出公制换算。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 s.12(1) 的合同无效（s.12(4)）；罚则见一般条款，v0.1 未逐条核对。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The packing in Sri Lanka of any article in a container for the purpose of sale shall be according to any one of the authorised units of measurement, specified in Part I of the Third Schedule.
rules.notes: 生效日以认证日标注；本法第 1 条规定由部长指定施行日，指定令未取得（见 README open questions #4）。

rules.law_name: Measurement Units, Standards and Services Act, No. 35 of 1995 计量单位、标准与服务法
rules.requirement: 不得对商品或物品的数量、计量、规格或重量作出虚假、不正确或不真实的声明；不得交付少于所要求或所表示数量的商品。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面标称容量/重量与实际规格书、包装标示的对照；抽检记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 罚款不超过 2,500 卢比或 6 个月以下监禁，或并罚（1995 年文本）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any person who, in any place or area, by any means whatsoever, whether direct or indirect, makes any false, incorrect or untrue declaration or statement as to the number, quantity, measure, gauge or weight of any goods or things in connection with their purchase, sale, weighing or measurement …
rules.notes: 原文该句后接 ‘or in the computation of any charges … or who sells … short of the quantity demanded’；引文以省略号截取，未改动前半句用词。

rules.law_name: Measurement Units, Standards and Services Act, No. 35 of 1995 计量单位、标准与服务法
rules.requirement: 对部长以宪报命令指定的‘特定预包装商品’，包装者或进口商须以规定方式在包装上标明：以法定单位表示的数量（重量/体积/长度），以及其名称与地址（或可据此查得名称地址的标记）。
rules.evidence_needed: 该品类是否已被指定为 specified packaged goods（宪报命令）、包装标示照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: s.51(6)：短装或未按法定单位标示，罚款不超过 2,000 卢比或 1 年以下监禁，或并罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: It shall be the duty of any person who is a packer or an importer of any specified packaged goods to ensure that such package is marked in the prescribed manner with— (a) a statement of the quantity contained in authorised units either of weight or of volume or of length; and (b) his name and address or a mark which enables his name and address to be readily ascertained by an inspector.
rules.notes: 仅适用于部长指定品类；v0.1 未取得指定清单，见 README open questions #5。

rules.law_name: Sri Lanka Standards Institution Act, No. 6 of 1984 斯里兰卡标准协会法
rules.requirement: 部长可依 SLSI 理事会建议，以宪报命令把某一标准对应的认证标志宣布为某类商品的强制认证标志；命令自指定日期起生效，且不得早于命令作出后三个月。
rules.evidence_needed: 该品类是否已有强制认证标志命令（宪报编号与生效日）、标准编号（SLS）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 本条为授权条款；违反效果见 s.23 与相关罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Minister may, subject to the provisions of sections 17, 18, 19, subsection (2) of this section, and section 21, by Order published in the Gazette, on the recommendation of the Council, declare a certification mark which has been accepted in respect of a standard specification approved by it for any commodity or product or for the manufacture, production, processing or treatment of any commodity or product to be, with effect from a date specified in the Order, a compulsory certification mark in respect for that commodity or product or for the manufacture, production, processing or treatment of any commodity or product and may in like manner abolish or amend any such mark.
rules.notes: 适用性触发条款：只有被命令覆盖的品类才有强制认证义务；SLSI 官网 Cloudflare 拦截，命令清单未取得。

rules.law_name: Sri Lanka Standards Institution Act, No. 6 of 1984 斯里兰卡标准协会法
rules.requirement: 当某类商品已被宣布适用强制认证标志后，任何人不得在指定日期后销售该商品，除非持有总干事签发的许可，且该商品符合相关标准规格或按该标准规格生产。
rules.evidence_needed: SLSI 许可编号与有效期、标准符合性证书、标签上的 SLS 标志与许可号。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 s.23 构成该法项下的 offence；具体罚则见本法罚则条款（v0.1 未逐条核对）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where the Minister has by Order under section 20, declared a certification mark to be a compulsory certification mark for any commodity or product, or for the manufacture, production, processing or treatment of any commodity or product no person shall, with effect from the date specified in that Order sell that commodity or product— (a) except under a permit issued by the Director-General or other officer authorized in that behalf by the Director-General; and (b) unless that commodity or product— (i) complies with that relevant standard specification; or (ii) has been manufactured, produced, processed or treated in accordance with that relevant standard specification.
rules.notes: 页面展示 SLS 标志但无许可号时，只能写‘页面未展示许可信息，需向商家核实’。

rules.law_name: Sri Lanka Telecommunications Act, No. 25 of 1991 斯里兰卡电信法
rules.requirement: 未经委员会依 s.21(2) 签发的许可，任何人不得制造、进口、销售、要约销售、经营、转让、出租、演示、维护或修理任何电信设备。
rules.evidence_needed: TRCSL 供应商许可（Vendors Licence）编号、类型核准（type approval）记录、进口商名称。
rules.penalty_or_note: 构成该法项下的 offence；具体罚则见罚则条款（v0.1 未逐条核对）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No person shall, except under the authority of a licence issued by the Authority under subsection (2) for that purpose— (a) manufacture, import, sell, offer for sale, deal in, transfer, hire, lease, demonstrate, maintain or repair by way of trade any telecommunication apparatus; or
rules.notes: ‘telecommunication apparatus’ 的边界（含 Wi-Fi/蓝牙设备）由 TRCSL 规则与类型核准范围决定，需按 SKU 核实。

rules.law_name: Sri Lanka Telecommunications Act, No. 25 of 1991 斯里兰卡电信法
rules.requirement: 委员会有权批准可接入电信系统的设备类型（type approval）；具体核准程序与标签要求由 TRCSL 规则与许可条件规定。
rules.evidence_needed: TRCSL 类型核准编号与证书、设备铭牌/包装上的核准标识。
rules.penalty_or_note: 本条为委员会职权条款；违反效果依 s.21 许可制度与相关规则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: to approve types of telecommunication apparatus which may be connected to a telecommunication system ;
rules.notes: v0.1 未取得 TRCSL 类型核准规则全文（官网设备页由脚本加载），只引法律授权条款，见 README open questions #6。
